sections.name: 阅读理解
sections.note: 每题 2 分。阅读所给文章，从四个选项中选出最佳答案。

passage.title: Volunteering and the first job
passage.text: Employers say they value volunteering, but students often suspect that only impressive internships count. A survey of graduate recruiters suggests the students are half right. Volunteering was rarely listed as a requirement, yet interviewers frequently asked candidates to describe a situation where they had worked with others to solve a problem. A term spent organising a food bank shift supplied better answers than a month of photocopying in an office. The value lies less in the activity itself than in the evidence it provides of reliability, coordination and persistence.

sections.name: 写作
sections.note: 本题 12 分。按题目要求写一篇短文。

items.stem: Write an essay of about 150 words on the following topic: some students believe only internships matter for finding a job. Give your view with examples.

answer.text: Students often assume that only internships count when employers read a CV. Recruiters tell a more nuanced story. Volunteering is seldom a formal requirement, but interviews are built around questions about teamwork and problem solving, and a term spent running a food bank shift answers those questions better than a month of photocopying. What matters is not the label of the activity but the evidence it supplies: reliability, coordination, persistence. Students should therefore choose activities by the responsibilities they involve rather than by the prestige of the organisation. A well-documented volunteering role can be worth more than a famous name on a certificate.

explain.right: 先定三段骨架（描述—分析—结论），再把题目给出的信息逐条落进段落，最后检查字数与衔接词。
explain.wrong: 常见错误：把实习与志愿对立起来，或只强调「志愿活动加分」而不说明原因。
